title: Zero-Copy WebAssembly GRIB Meteorological Grid Decoding via eccodes-wasm
author: God's Eye View / Antigravity Cognitive Audit

claims.assertion: Raw GRIB2 atmospheric forecast grids from NOAA GFS and ECMWF IFS can be unpacked client-side in sub-100ms via WebAssembly-compiled ECMWF eccodes without native C binary dependencies.
